## 變更類型 / Type of change

- [ ] 錯誤修正 / Bug fix
- [ ] 新功能 / New feature
- [ ] 題庫新增或修正 / Question bank addition or fix
- [ ] 無障礙改善 / Accessibility improvement
- [ ] 文件 / Documentation
- [ ] 重構、測試或其他 / Refactor, tests or other

## 測試方式 / How was this tested?

<!-- 說明你如何驗證這次變更 / Describe how you verified this change -->

## 檢查清單 / Checklist

- [ ] `bun test` 通過 / `bun test` passes
- [ ] `bun run check:banks` 通過 / `bun run check:banks` passes
- [ ] 沒有加入執行期依賴、外部資源，或內嵌的程式與樣式 / No runtime dependencies, external resources, or inline scripts and styles were added
- [ ] DOM 以 `h()`／`textContent` 建立，沒有使用 `innerHTML` / DOM is built with `h()` / `textContent`, never `innerHTML`
- [ ] 介面變更已確認鍵盤操作、淺色與深色主題，以及 375px 手機寬度 / Interface changes were checked with the keyboard, in light and dark themes, and at a 375px mobile width
- [ ] 已同步更新中英文文件與 CHANGELOG 的 `[Unreleased]`（如適用） / Both language versions of the docs and `[Unreleased]` in the CHANGELOG are updated (if applicable)
- [ ] 題庫變更已附上依據來源，且內容可以公開 / Bank changes cite a source and the content may be published
- [ ] Commit 訊息遵循 Conventional Commits / Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
